headline: Focus Lighting wins Rs 7.5 cr order from Ingka Centres
summary: Focus Lighting & Fixtures secures a Rs 7.5 crore order from Ingka Centres for LED lighting. This follows two Rs 13.5 crore orders from L&T earlier in the quarter.

headline: Kotyark Industries fined ₹2.6 lakh for Q1FY27 delay
summary: Kotyark Industries Ltd has been penalized ₹1,29,800 each by NSE and BSE for delayed submission of unaudited financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. The delay stemmed from auditor transition issues.

headline: ESDS Software seeks approval for director appointments
summary: ESDS Software Solution has issued a postal ballot notice for shareholder approval on remuneration revisions for top management and the appointment of a new Whole-time Director.

headline: Motherson subsidiary fined $48,432 in US tax audit
summary: Samvardhana Motherson International's US subsidiary SMR Automotive Systems was penalized USD 48,432 by Michigan Treasury for corporate income tax short payment. The company states no material financial impact.

headline: United Foodbrands to host investor meet in Mumbai
summary: United Foodbrands Limited will host a non-deal roadshow with Equirus in Mumbai on September 16-17, 2026. The one-on-one meetings are scheduled under SEBI LODR regulations.

headline: Gokaldas Exports to hold investor meetings in Bengaluru
summary: Gokaldas Exports Limited has scheduled one-to-one physical meetings with institutional investors and research analysts on September 17 and 18, 2026, in Bengaluru.

headline: Tempsens Instruments Q1FY27 earnings call on Sep 17
summary: Tempsens Instruments (India) Ltd will host its Q1FY27 earnings conference call on September 17, 2026. Management to discuss financial performance for the quarter ended June 30, 2026.

headline: JTL Defence Q1FY27 Results: Revaluation Depreciation Masks Profit
summary: JTL Defence reported a net loss of ₹267.16 lakh in Q1FY27, driven by ₹277.90 lakh in additional depreciation from asset revaluation. Revenue rose to ₹2,124.47 lakh. The company also flagged risks regarding long-standing investments and tax notices.

headline: Kanungo Financiers Q1FY27 Results & Auditor Resignation
summary: Kanungo Financiers approved Q1FY26 unaudited results and accepted the resignation of statutory auditor H S K & Co LLP due to bandwidth constraints on August 14, 2026.

headline: Shivansh Finserve auditor resigns over bandwidth
summary: Shivansh Finserve Ltd approved Q1FY27 results on August 14, 2026. Statutory auditor H S K & Co LLP and WTD Jignesh Shah resigned. No financial data disclosed.

headline: Patels Airtemp wins Rs 226 crore order from Dangote Nigeria
summary: Confirmed fixed-price contract for international project. Value is 2.4x avg quarterly revenue. No prior order history in last 3 quarters. Execution and cash conversion to be monitored.

headline: Gland Pharma fined ₹1.40 lakh for director appointment breach
summary: Gland Pharma paid a combined ₹1.40 lakh penalty to NSE and BSE for a technical breach of SEBI LODR norms regarding the appointment of an independent director over 75. The company settled the full amount suo motu to ensure timely closure.
